work.name: Polarising
work.summary: Creating a CI/CD pipeline in GitLab to be used by over 60 Maven projects.
highlights: Developed and maintained a centralized GitLab CI/CD pipeline that supports 60+ Maven-based projects, including main, release, hotfix, bugfix, and feature branches. Introduced a configurable YAML templating framework to streamline shared logic across branches, reducing duplication, and making updates easier and safer. SonarQube and automated testing have been integrated directly into the development workflow to ensure code quality and security. Created a sophisticated orchestration file that modifies pipeline behavior based on the current branch and user-defined inputs, while also providing controls through variables for skipping maven tests, skipping maven javadoc creation, and setting Maven flags.
Managed Kubernetes manifests and set up automated, GitOps-style deployments across all 60+ projects with ArgoCD.

work.name: OpenCascade, part of Capgemini
work.summary: Revamping a legacy app's infrastructure from Airflow to a proprietary system with Zookeeper and Kafka.
highlights: Responsible for the migration of the infrastructure of a legacy application (written in Python, C++, Kotlin, and Golang) to a proprietary solution using Zookeeper and Kafka, reducing resource consumption by 10%. The responsibilities include: designing the new logic flow that includes the proprietary solution, creating Docker containers, Helm Charts, and GitLab pipelines to deploy to the Kubernetes cluster.
Developing a solution that installed all required tools on developers' machines through Ansible.
